Description=Let Him Cook door (MCP)
After=network.target
[Service]
User=lhc
WorkingDirectory=/home/lhc/fantasy
ExecStart=/home/lhc/fantasy/server/venv/bin/python /home/lhc/fantasy/server/door.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

157-230-82-39.sslip.io {
  encode gzip
  handle /door/* {
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8766
  }
  handle {
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8765
  }
}
